222-527-1115-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1115-8249.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Defiant Salvager twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

643-5231-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
643-5231-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the artifact creature, adding {R}
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.

512-2085-3814.easyPrerequisites: Argothian Elder and Kelpie Guide do not have summoning sickness.
512-2085-3814.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two mana-producing lands that can collectively tap to produce {W}{W}.
512-2085-3814.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping the two lands.
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kelpie Guide and Argothian Elder, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

728-2445-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
728-2445-5254.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat.

147-2511-5100.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2511-5100.description:
Cast Return Upon the Tide by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Return Upon the Tide.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Return Upon the Tide
Resolve the Return Upon the Tide copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-5220-5631-6961-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-5220-5631-6961-7824.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

3457-4171-7791.description:
Activate Kozilek's Channeler by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Kozilek's Channeler.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Kozilek's Channeler.
Repeat.

423-1362-3609-4011.easyPrerequisites: Magistrate's Scepter has at least one charge counter on it.
423-1362-3609-4011.description:
Play Oboro, Palace in the Clouds.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Evolution Sage triggers, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 1 twice more.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2999-4186-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2999-4186-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

628-2921-7191.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Bristlebane Battler.
When Bristlebane Battler dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

2292-5795-6871-6879.description:
Cast Barkform Harvester by paying {3}.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Barkform Harvester.
When Barkform Harvester dies, Haru triggers, returning Barkform Harvester from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

465-803-3742-4251-7060.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1651-2499-2638-4935-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-2499-2638-4935-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-2499-2638-4935-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers twice due to Yarok, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

1482-2854-4574-5849.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1482-2854-4574-5849.description:
Cast Jeweled Lotus either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

141-313-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-313-5686.description:
Cast Corpse Dance by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Corpse Dance.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Corpse Dance.
Resolve the Corpse Dance copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3197-4476-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-4476-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2060-3054-5231-6701.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
2060-3054-5231-6701.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
2060-3054-5231-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana value of the card in your graveyard.

3490-4659-4733-6242.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Dictate of Erebos triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Legate Lanius triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat until no opponent controls a creature.
3490-4659-4733-6242.notes: You may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponents control, using the Servo generated from the last iteration.

413-618-1734.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter token's trigger, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token.
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
When Kiki-Jiki enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 6.
Repeat.

requires.n: Artifact Creature that is a Gnome and/or Artificer

2527-4050-4073-4917--75.notablePrerequisites:
Jan Jansen and the additional Gnome or Artificer do not have a +1/+1 counter on them.
You control at least one additional artifact creature.
2527-4050-4073-4917--75.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact creature you control except the Gnome or Artificer.
Jan Jansen triggers, causing it and creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Jan Jansen, adding {B}.
When Jan Jansen dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing the Gnome or Artificer.
When the Gnome or Artificer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Retribution of the Ancients by paying {B} and removing the +1/+1 counter from Jan Jansen and the other Gnome or Artificer, giving a creature -2/-2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

3719-4264-4893-5326.notablePrerequisites: Altered Ego has a power of at least 2.
3719-4264-4893-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Altered Ego and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Altered Ego from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Altered Ego to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Altered Ego enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Altered Ego by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

337-1680-3525-4508.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other artifact.
Pemmin's Aura and Runed Stalactite attached to Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Embraal Gear-Smasher does not have summoning sickness.
337-1680-3525-4508.description:
Activate Embraal Gear-Smasher by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token for each opponent dealt damage by Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Repeat.

578-2043-3989.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three artifact cards in hand.
578-2043-3989.description:
If needed, activate Swiftfoot Boots' equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Metalworker.
Activate Metalworker by tapping it and revealing at least four artifact cards from your hand, adding at least eight {C}.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Metalworker that is a 1/1 Soldier.
Activate Swiftfoot Boots' equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Metalworker token.
Repeat from step 2 using the Metalworker token instead.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may target any artifact you control to get infinite copies of them.

944-1631-4050-5220.description:
Cast Battalion Foot Soldier by paying {W}.
When Battalion Foot Soldier enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Battalion Foot Soldier, adding {W}.
When Battalion Foot Soldier dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Battalion Foot Soldier from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Batallion Foot Soldier trigger from step 2, causing you to search your library for Batallion Foot Soldier and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

678-2452-4496.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying {0}.
When Accursed Centaur enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning it to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

803-969-3742-4251-4344.notablePrerequisites:
"Samurai" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
803-969-3742-4251-4344.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Lumbering Battlement.
The token Lumbering Battlement enters the battlefield, exiling Godo until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
At the end of your combat phase, the token Lumbering Battlement triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
The token Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

3094-3401.notablePrerequisites:
Artifacts you control can tap to produce at least {4}.
You are able to cast Blinkmoth Infusion.
3094-3401.description:
Cast Blinkmoth Infusion by paying its mana cost reduced by the number of artifacts you control.
Holding priority, activate all mana-producing artifacts you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a copy of Blinkmoth Infusion.
Resolve the Blinkmoth Infusion copy, untapping all artifacts.
Repeat from step 2.

751-2060-2265-2854.notablePrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds has 2 or 3 lore counters on it.
751-2060-2265-2854.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake, putting 2 +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler with Showdown of the Skalds.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Crystalline Crawler to add {U}.
Shrieking Drake triggers, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.

719-3638.description:
Cast Turntimber Ranger by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Turntimber Ranger enters the battlefield, creating a 2/2 Wolf creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on Turntimber Ranger.
2/2 Wolf creature token enters the battlefield triggering Turntimber Ranger, creating a 2/2 Wolf creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on Turntimber Ranger.
Repeat from step 2.
